slug: 2025-02-27 Senegal unveils New Deal Technologique digital transformation strategy

facts.fact: Biometric Update says President Bassirou Diomaye Faye "launched" the New Deal Technologique digital-transformation strategy on 24 February 2025, within the Senegal 2050 agenda.
Biometric Update describes the strategy as running to 2034 and does not say whether its text is public; the stated period includes February 2025. Text public: not stated.

Biometric Update gives an estimated budget of $1.7bn for the strategy (attributed to Ecofin) and targets of 95% internet coverage, over 150,000 digital jobs and at least 500 startups by 2034; the source describes no separate action plan.

systems.tiers: national; universal internet, unique biometric digital ID, single citizen portal, integrated services platform
